name: Nidoran-M (CobbleEffort form)
look: a little charcoal beast with spiky fur, big red-edged ears, an orange-gold eye under a glowing red mark, small white fangs, red dorsal spines and a big round magma-red rump
entry: The magma in its rump keeps it warm through the coldest nights. When it senses danger it raises the red spines on its back, and they glow hot enough to blister a paw that touches them.
how: Wild: uncommon in badlands, savannas and volcanic biomes.
Evolves into the CobbleEffort Nidorino at level 16.
